description.value: Both parties initiate, both refuse, and research questions are set jointly. The highest rung, and rarer in the register than the Consortium's own summaries suggest.
Obe strani sprožata in zavračata stike, raziskovalna vprašanja pa se postavljajo skupaj.

Ambas as partes tomam a iniciativa, ambas recusam, e as perguntas de investigação são definidas em conjunto. O degrau mais alto e, no registo, mais raro do que os resumos do próprio Consórcio dão a entender.
